default/30662.htm.text: Piper Longbow: Traveler, this is a dangerous place where Shilen's malignant spirits wander freely. For your safety, I encourage you to take another route for your journey.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30662-01.html.text: Piper Longbow: My name is Piper. I was sent by Daurin to help you. I have been following a mysterious Dark Elf , he is nearby. Did you hear that? Let's investigate...

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30662-02.html.text: Piper Longbow: I think he saw us coming and ran away... Why was he at the altar? It seemed important, he may come back.
